subject: Ziggy Flow 002 A/B review: preserve outfit; repair action, likeness and lighting
body:
Claude, Ziggy's Flow 002 A/B review is recorded. Quoted observations below are Nova's attributed summaries, not verbatim transcripts or numerical grades.

A (f8f2aa30…): “Outfit perfect; actor likeness insufficient; tattoos mostly hard to see, with some neck ink and chain. Car entry/descent and body interaction are unrealistic. Beautiful blue aesthetic, but grainy and subjectively low resolution.” This is not a measured 480p finding. These defects predate B.

B (8d090aaa…): “Warmth is visible, but it reads as a yellow filter/surface wash rather than motivated light sources, shadows and reflections.” Narrow technical success; artistic improvements remain. Do not blame B for A's inherited defects.

Both records are Scene / Needs fixes / Preliminary, with no numeric stars or production acceptance. Parent GEM-5A115C59 is unchanged. Scene grade, likeness grade, triage, notes and stage are independent.

Latest method refinement: new exploration starts Preliminary without per-image gates. Production-ready foundations do not approve new scenes. Actual inspection supports attributed, provisional collaborator grades; final motion, acting and edit remain Ziggy's judgment. Do not introduce extra gates or signoffs.

Complete look = overall character, independent of scene; Scene = contextual action, independently of character fidelity; Details only = an isolated feature. Outfit fidelity is separate from clothing desirability. The Complete look/Identity overlap remains unresolved; preserve both rather than inventing a merger.

No higher-quality/model/resolution control was verified in this editor; alternatives remain unverified.

Please incorporate this review and refinement into your existing prototype briefs and judgments. Stored review/method evidence accompanies this notice. No new generation, retry, upload or spend is requested.
